prompt: Under a circus big top, a female tightrope walker is balancing on a high wire, holding a long pole decorated with three red ribbons. Directly below her, a large safety net is stretched taut. To her right and slightly lower, a male acrobat is hanging upside down from a swinging trapeze, holding on with his knees. The tightrope walker is higher than the acrobat. The tightrope walker is looking forward, along the wire. The acrobat is holding his arms out towards the tightrope walker. A single, powerful spotlight is pointed at the tightrope walker. A clown is standing on the ground below the net, holding a bunch of balloons and pointing up at the acrobat. The number of balloons is two more than the number of ribbons on the pole. The balancing pole is longer than the trapeze bar. The clown's costume is more colorful and has more patterns than the tightrope walker's simple leotard.
